secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing key for auth tokens (any random string, 32+ chars)

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
secrets.description: Optional: Cloudinary cloud name, for candidate resume uploads (Cloudinary dashboard → Product Environment Credentials)

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional: Cloudinary API key (same dashboard page)

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional: Cloudinary API secret (same dashboard page)

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional: Resend API key, for invitation emails (resend.io → API Keys); without it emails are skipped

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Optional: Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client ID, for Google Calendar sync. Enable the Google Calendar API and add the redirect URI https://8000-<preview-host>/calendar/google/callback

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional: Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client Secret (same Google Cloud Credentials page)
